datasets.name: UAV-captured landslide images from Nam Khanh, Bac Ha District, Lao Cai Province, Vietnam
datasets.verbatim: The dataset consists of UAV-captured landslide images from Nam Khanh, Bac Ha District, Lao Cai Province, Vietnam, as illustrated in Fig. 7.

methods.name: Generative AI-enhanced pixel segmentation approach
methods.summary: A framework that classifies low-quality UAV images (low-light, overexposed, cloud-covered) using Laplacian variance and brightness thresholds, enhances them using a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), and performs landslide detection using U-Net-based pixel segmentation models.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes a novel approach that integrates pixel segmentation algorithms with generative artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance UAV image-based landslide detection in challenging lighting and atmospheric conditions.

availability.author_statement: Stated as 'No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study.'

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory dataset is not linked or referenced, and the custom code for the generative AI-enhanced pixel segmentation approach lacks a repository or persistent link.
